textContent.text: Offenders who take part in problem-solving court programs typically do not go to jail. Instead, a judge, a team of service providers, and other members of the community connect the offender to resources that can help them and closely monitor their progress. These resources can include counseling, medical treatment, educational programs, and employment support. The offender may also participate in community service as a way of addressing the damage done by his or her crime.
